title: Client Mirror code versus pFedHN full-model generation
hypothesis: On held-out non-IID client partitions of sklearn Digits, a shared classifier with four per-client Givens View angles reaches within 2 accuracy points of a pFedHN-style full-model generator after 20 support updates, with lower actual server/client bytes and client download volume, and is not dominated by byte-near FiLM codes.
mirror_coordinate: Four per-client Givens angles on four fixed hidden-unit pairs (0,1),(2,3),(4,5),(6,7)

draw.eligible_rule: P0 + UNTESTED; exclude IDs with live origin/research/ma-* branches or pre-existing experiments/mirror_applications/ma-* directories

data.version: pinned in source/data_manifest.json after protocol freeze
data.client_distribution: per-class Dirichlet assignment alpha=0.5; within each class shuffle once and assign each example to a client sampled from its Dirichlet proportions; all samples assigned once per world
data.within_client_split: After client assignment, shuffle each client's indices using the world RNG. Train clients: floor(60%) train, floor(20%) dev, remainder audit; unseen clients: floor(60%) support, remainder audit query. Persist exact indices and counts.

model.pFedHN_style: client embedding z in R^8 -> shared 2-layer hypernetwork -> all 2410 client MLP parameters
model.mirror: shared MLP plus four Givens angles per client, rotating four fixed hidden activation pairs
model.film_control: shared MLP plus client code in R^4 projected to hidden gamma/beta by shared learned bases
model.global_control: one MLP shared by all clients, no client code

training.checkpoint_selection: lowest mean development cross-entropy on the ten training clients; patience 8
training.local_adaptation: For pFedHN/Mirror/FiLM update only that unseen client's embedding/angles/code using 20 full-batch support Adam steps; shared parameters remain frozen. For global control report 0 steps only. For independent control train that client's full local model for 20 full-batch steps. Report fixed checkpoints at 0, 5, 20 steps; exact update target and number of examples are included in results.
training.local_adaptation_optimizer: Adam, learning_rate=0.01, betas=(0.9,0.999), eps=1e-8; no weight decay
training.initial_client_code: zeros for all methods; unseen pFedHN/Mirror/FiLM code begins at zero
training.independent_unseen_control: fresh independently initialized local MLP per held-out client, initialized from that world/model seed, then trained only on support for 20 full-batch Adam steps at lr=0.01
training.optimization_accounting: record train examples consumed and optimizer steps; shared methods use minibatches of 128 per client per epoch; code adaptation uses all support examples per step

controls: pFedHN-style central hypernetwork and client embeddings
Shared MLP with four-angle Mirror client views
Byte-near shared MLP plus four-dimensional FiLM code
metrics: seen-client and unseen-client query accuracy and cross-entropy
actual serialized central/server model and client-code bytes
one-time shared-base and per-client download bytes
local adaptation updates and client model-generation MACs
CPU batch-1 latency, client personalization wall time
success_gate: Mirror is within 2 accuracy points of pFedHN after 20 support updates on both unseen clients in >=2/3 worlds; central model plus registered-client payload <=80% of pFedHN; per-client code download after base cached <=25% of a generated full model; and Mirror is not dominated by byte-near FiLM. Each held-out client's query metric is reported separately; pooled metrics are supplementary.
boundaries: Client partitions are simulated from one small dataset.
The pFedHN-style control is a direct compact-code-to-full-MLP reimplementation, not a reproduction of every paper detail.
No privacy, secure aggregation, real-user or production federated claim.
